verdict.rationale: Metronome documents subscription lifecycle management (upgrades, downgrades, seat changes, pricing overrides) and revenue recognition with daily granularity, implying some proration capability, but there is no explicit documentation of a proration formula, credit calculation, or invoice line-item reconciliation to the penny for mid-cycle plan changes. In fact docs-29 suggests price changes take effect only 'at the start of the next billing period' rather than being prorated mid-cycle, which is at odds with the story's expectation of mid-cycle proration math. Missing for 10: explicit proration algorithm/documentation, worked examples of prorated credits and partial-period invoice lines, and evidence of penny-accurate reconciliation or audit trail for such changes.
